answer: Give every agent work a pigment: a hash-chained watermark mixed from its last twenty sealed contributions, so each deliverable is stained by the history that paid for it. A hollow identity fresh from the faucet has no stain to show - its first output is colorless, and colorless work routes to quarantine, not to market. Verification is a vertex: at every handoff the stain is re-mixed against the ledger, and any mismatch forks the chain into review. Sybil farms can mint identities cheaply, but they cannot mint twenty epochs of honest labor; without it, the pigment never forms.
